model_annotation: This 3D-style line plot illustrates the convergence of loss values over iterations for five different models or configurations, with the vertical axis labeled "Loss" and the horizontal axis labeled "#Iteration". The x-axis is linearly scaled, ranging from 0 to 140,000, with tick marks at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis is also linearly scaled, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Five distinct lines are shown, each representing a different model: "Vanilla" (purple dashed line), "StrmLLM (n=64)" (blue solid line), "SepLLM (n=64)" (orange solid line), "SepLLM (n=64, H)" (green solid line), and "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (red solid line), along with "SepLLM (n=128)" (dark blue solid line). All lines start at a loss value of approximately 3.3 at iteration 0 and decrease monotonically as iterations progress. The "Vanilla" model (purple) consistently exhibits the highest loss throughout training, starting at ~3.3 and ending near 2.5 at 140,000 iterations. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" (blue) and "SepLLM (n=128)" (dark blue) models show similar performance, with losses dropping to around 2.55–2.58 by the end. The "SepLLM (n=64)" (orange), "SepLLM (n=64, H)" (green), and "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (red) models converge to lower losses, ending near 2.5–2.53. All lines show a steep initial decline followed by a gradual flattening, indicating diminishing returns in loss reduction as training progresses. The plot includes a legend in the upper right corner to identify each line.
